answer: The ferrous counter is kept in knoll and violet exposes each reset. Anyone as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4891 identities would post 4748 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
